column1: # Central government portals, by journey. Research pointers, NOT evidence.
# The 800 hostname capture is Gujarat only. Almost everything on the expansion
# list is central: a passport is the Ministry of External Affairs, Aadhaar is
# UIDAI, company and startup registration are MCA and DPIIT, insolvency is IBBI.
# None of it lives under gujarat.gov.in, so none of it appears in
# docs/gujarat-domains.md and no amount of classifying that file will find it.
# READ THIS BEFORE USING ANY LINE HERE.
# Unlike the GSWAN file, this is not a government publication we captured. It is
# a starting list, written down so a research pass knows which door to knock on.
# Every row is UNVERIFIED. A row being here means "go look here", it does not
# mean the URL is live, current, or the right one, and it is never a citation.
# The rule from docs/research/README.md is unchanged and absolute: a fact reaches
# a citizen only with a verbatim quote from a page somebody actually fetched, and
# that fetch goes in the ledger. Confirm the URL first, quote second. Anything
# that cannot be quoted is notFound and renders as "Not verified yet".
# Journey names match the seed bundle ids we intend to build, so this file is
# also the coverage checklist. A journey with no rows here has not been scoped.
